text: As the Toronto Transit Commission operates a transit service on Neilson Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services has reviewed the need for traffic control signals at the intersection of Neilson Road and Oakmeadow Boulevard (north intersection). Based on the assessment undertaken, Transportation Services does not recommend the installation of traffic control signals at this intersection as the warrant criteria was not met.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until the first regular meeting of Scarborough Community Council that occurs after a local public meeting is held to discuss the traffic control signals at the intersection of Neilson Road and Oakmeadow Boulevard (north intersection).
